tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// bstan srung beg tse lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi yi ge bsam don ltad mor rtsen pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs// sngags rig grub pa'i lcags kyus btab tsam gyis// bstan srung dregs pa rang dbang bkol bzod pa// 'khor lo'i mgon po gshin rje'i dgrar btud de// bka' sdod dregs pa dgyes pa'i bsang mchod 'dri// 'di'i bsang rdzas spyi ltar dang*/ spro na smug rtsis byugs pa'i gtor ma rgyan ldan bshams la spyan 'dren pa ni 'di skad do// hūm̐ dbang ldan ma ru rtse yi dur khrod che// brag dmar mchang gling me rlung 'khrugs pa'i gnas// bse mkhar thod pa brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// sgrol gying srog bdag dmar po gshegs su gsol// srid pa'i bu mo las mkhan srog bdud dmar// gri thogs brgyad dang shan pa nyi shu gcig /btsan bdud gshin rje la sogs mi sdug pa'i// 'khor tshogs shan pa'i tshogs bcas gnas 'dir gshegs// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ steng phyogs bka' srol brgyud pa gshin rje'i gshed// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i 'og /bka' sdod skyes bu dmar po lcam dral ni// 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs su gsol// gsal gdab pa ni/ mdun du mi rta'i khrag gi rgya mtsho che// dba' rlabs g.yo bar gdug pa'i srog chags rtse// zangs ri dmar po sra brtan padma nyi// mi rta dgra bgegs dbugs bral bsnol ba'i steng*// srog bdag skyes bu dmar po beg tse can// padma rā ga'i lhun por bskal pa'i mes// lan brgyar 'khyud lta'i gzi brjid lham me bas// bdud dgra'i snying la mi bzad mun pa gtibs// phyag g.yas zangs gri rnon po mkhar 'phyar zhing*// bstan dgra'i mgo lus srog rtsa gcod phyir bsnun// g.yon pas dgra snying 'bigs pa'i mda' gzhu dang*// don snying khrag gi rgyun 'bab bsnams shing 'dred// bse mdung dmar po mchan khung g.yon par brten// zhal gdangs rno dkar mche ba'i zla tshes gtsigs// spyan gsum dmar zlum dgra la khrag mig blta// sku la dar dmar ral gu zangs khrab bgos// nyi 'od la 'khu zangs rmog dbur brgyan cing*// ra skyes kham pa'i pags pa lding thabs gyon// mi mgo'i phreng brgyan sag ti'i lh+wam ldan zhabs// brkyang bskum dor stabs me dpung klong na bzhengs// g.yon du rig pa'i lha mo sku mdog mthing*// bse gdong dmar por khrag gi mig gsum g.yo// phyag gnyis zangs gri 'phyar zhing phur bus 'debs// dred mor zhon nas stong gsum dgra bgegs 'tshol// gtso bo'i g.yas phyogs las mkhan shan pa dmar// sku la ber dang bse yi khrab rmog bgos// mdung dmar dgra la bsnun cing zhags pas 'ching*// ce spyang la zhon nam gyi gung la rgyu// srog gcod gying brgyad shan pa nyi shu gcig

/myur mgyogs btsan dmar srog gcod bdud nag stong*// gsod byed gshin rje mi sdug gnod sbyin stong*// sha zan srin po nad bdag ma mo 'bum// phung byed the'u rang sde tshogs grangs med kyi// bka' nyan 'khor tshogs mang pos bskor bar gsal// bsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod rdzas dngos po rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang*// bsang rdzas phyi nang mchod rdzas bskal pa'i bar// bsang mgron kun gyi dbang po lnga yi yul// bsang mchod rgyun mi chad par gnas gyur cig /bstan srung 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas ni// mchod yon dag byed phung po'i rlabs phreng g.yo// bung ba'i glu len dri ldan me tog bkra// lhan cig skyes sbyar spos dud mkha' la 'khyud// sgrib pa'i mun 'phrog mar me'i phreng ba bstar// reg na bsil pa'i bde ster dri chab mtsho// ro drug bcud ldan zhal zas ri bo spungs// snyan brjid sgra dbyangs rol mo rna ba'i dpyid// khyad par khrag chang sbyar ba'i mchod yon dang*// dbang lnga'i me tog sha chen dud pa'i sprin// zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri mchog 'khyil// sha rus gtor ma dung chen rol mo 'bul// pha rol 'joms pa'i mda' mdung mtshon cha dang*// rang srung byed pa bse yi khrab rmog phub// mi sdug skad 'byin dur khrod 'byung po'i bya// mche sder rtsal gyis dregs pa'i gcan gzan rigs// rta dmar rnga rngog g.yo zhing lhang lhang mtsher// g.yag rgod ra skyes dar gyis brgyan pa dang*// dri zhim spos dang lha shing bsregs pa'i sprin// dbyar dus nam mkha'i glang po'i rjes 'gro bas// zhing kun bgrod pas dbang po tshim byed cing*// nyes sgrib sbyong ba'i bsang mchod rgya chen 'di// bla ma yi dam gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa// bka' sdod gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral dang*// las mkhan srog bdag gri thogs shan pa'i sde// bdud btsan gshin rje gnod sbyin srin po dang*// ma mo the'u rang sde tshogs bcas pa la// bsang dang phyi nang mchod gtor 'bul gyis bzhes// bstod pa ni/

bstan dgra dam nyams 'tsho ba'i rgyun gcod cing*// bstan pa de 'dzin skyong ba'i mthu stobs dang*// rdzu 'phrul thogs med srog bdag skyes bu dmar// lcam dral 'khor tshogs bcas la bstod par bgyi// mnga' gsol zhing phrin las bskul ba ni/ rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyi// bka' dang dam tshig la gnas srung ma khyod// chos mdzad bka' skyong gnyen por mnga' gsol na// gang bcol phrin las sgrub pa ma g.yel zhig /thabs shes yi ges mtshan bstan rgyas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes mchog rnams kyi sku tshe bsring*// sdom brtson bshad sgrub 'phel bar mnga' gsol na// dge 'dun sbyin bdag dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// gzhan phan byang chub sgrub por sdang sems can// gang dag byung ba lo zlar mi 'gyang bar// gsod byed shan pa'i sde dpon mnga' gsol na// sod rtags don snying khud pa da ltar stsol// gang du gnas kyang nyes phyogs kun las srungs// srid zhi'i bde legs 'dod dgur dbang 'byor ba'i// lam lha dgra lha mchog tu mnga' gsol na// nyin mtshan kun du srung skyob ma g.yel cig /gnam lo zla zhag rtsub pa'i keg dang sri// dgra 'dre byad mas brtsams pa'i gnod 'tshe'i rigs// thams cad bzlog byed rgyal por mnga' gsol na// gnod byed de de'i gshed du bzlog bsgyur mdzod// mchod bstod mnga' gsol lhur len rnal 'byor bdag /byang chub bar gyi skye bar dal 'byor ldan// gzhung lugs kun shes smra ba'i mchog grub par// lha srung rtag tu 'go bas phrin las sgrubs// bla ma lha srung thugs rje nus mthu yi// ma zlums mos pa'i mkha' dbyings rtag 'char bas// bsam don sna tshogs nyin mo'i ltad mo la// dgar rtsen skyid pa'i ga zha 'byin par shog /ces bstan srung beg tse lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi yi ge bsam don ltad mor rtsen pa'i nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/

bstan srung 'di la mos pa'i dge slong shākya bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi bas/ dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs ba gam gsum par sbyar ba swasti bi dza yantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
